findings.title: Readiness probe has not run yet
findings.cause: container api has run for 6m30s and is not ready because its readiness probe waits initialDelaySeconds 900 (15m0s) before its first check, so the pod gets no traffic until then, after every start and restart; Deployment api has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container api's readiness probe has initialDelaySeconds 900
container api started 6m30s ago and is not ready

findings.fix: For an app that starts slowly, give it a startupProbe (it holds the other probes back only until the app is up) and a short readiness initialDelaySeconds.
